args: Authorize one exact prospective call only: after the controlled 1-of-1 Ethereum Sepolia Safe installs the already deployed Firewall Guard through its owner-authorized setGuard operation, the Safe may make one zero-value CALL at the resulting exact nonce to 0x2e8cafa2053502cf29516f6e1d47cd59a8b9a6b4. The calldata is the four-byte owner() selector; it reads the Guard owner and has no asset or configuration effect. Do not authorize any transfer, different target or calldata, delegatecall, owner or threshold change, module activation, Guard removal, replay, or other Safe action. The installation is a separate owner-signed setup step; this mandate covers only the later exact Safe call, which requires a finalized canonical permit and relay attestation.
